text: The accepted MboxScanner OnStopRequest stores Continue status in an outer rv, then declares another rv while creating/starting the next pump. The later outer failure check does not observe an inner pump failure. Recommend one explicit status path when modifying this continuation, with a test for pump-creation or AsyncRead failure.
